## Feature / fix PR  → target: `staging`
- [ ] Branched from `staging` (`feature/*`, `fix/*`, `chore/*`, `docs/*`)
- [ ] CI green, conversations resolved
- [ ] Changeset added if this affects a published package (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] 1 teammate review requested

## Promotion PR  → target: `main` (Sinuhe only)
- [ ] Title: `promote: staging -> main (<date>)`
- [ ] Diff reviewed; release notes / version bumps confirmed
- [ ] Code-owner (Sinuhe) approval — required by branch protection
